006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupLine;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011
012import java.util.Locale;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
016
017/**
018 * A trait indicating that the implementation is a localized definition that is
019 * declared in-line as an instance.
020 *
021 * @param <DEFINITION>
022 *          the associated definition Java type
023 * @param <INSTANCE>
024 *          the associated instance Java type
025 */
026public interface IFeatureDefinitionInstanceInlined<
027    DEFINITION extends IDefinition,
028    INSTANCE extends INamedInstance>
029    extends IDefinition, INamedInstance {
030
031  @Override
032  default IEnhancedQName getDefinitionQName() {
033    return getReferencedDefinitionQName();
034  }
035
036  @Override
037  default DEFINITION getDefinition() {
038    return ObjectUtils.asType(this);
039  }
040
041  @Override
042  default boolean isInlineDefinition() {
043    return true;
044  }
045
046  @Override
047  default boolean isInline() {
048    // has to be inline
049    return true;
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  @NonNull
054  default INSTANCE getInlineInstance() {
055    return ObjectUtils.asType(this);
056  }
057
058  @Override
059  default String getEffectiveFormalName() {
060    return getFormalName();
061  }
062
063  @Override
064  default MarkupLine getEffectiveDescription() {
065    return getDescription();
066  }
067
068  @Override
069  default String getEffectiveName() {
070    // don't use use-name
071    return getName();
072  }
073
074  @Override
075  default Integer getEffectiveIndex() {
076    return getIndex();
077  }
078
079  @Override
080  @Nullable
081  default Object getEffectiveDefaultValue() {
082    // This is an inline instance that is both a definition and an instance. Don't
083    // delegate to the definition, since this would be redundant.
084    return getDefaultValue();
085  }
086
087  @Override
088  default ISource getSource() {
089    return getContainingModule().getSource();
090  }
091
092  /**
093   * Generates a "coordinate" string for the provided inline definition instance.
094   *
095   * A coordinate consists of the element's:
096   * <ul>
097   * <li>containing Metaschema module's short name
098   * <li>model type
099   * <li>definition name
100   * <li>hash code
101   * </ul>
102   *
103   * @return the coordinate
104   */
105  @SuppressWarnings("null")
106  @Override
107  default String toCoordinates() {
108    IModule module = getContainingModule();
109    return String.format("%s-inline-definition:%s:%s/%s@%d",
110        getModelType().toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT),
111        module.getShortName(),
112        getContainingDefinition().getName(),
113        getName(),
114        hashCode());
115  }
116}
